events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem across the empire.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Nero is emperor from AD 54; Crete is part of the Roman province of Crete and Cyrene.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written perhaps AD 62 to 65 (if by Paul), after the events of Acts

teaser.title: Paul passes Crete on his voyage to Rome
teaser.text: A stop at Fair Havens, about AD 59 (Acts 27:7-13).

teaser.title: Titus is written
teaser.text: Paul has left Titus on Crete and writes to him (if by Paul).

teaser.title: 1 and 2 Timothy
teaser.text: The other two Pastoral Epistles, written to Timothy.
